title: Cold War
start: Speak to Larry at Ardougne Zoo.

requirements.t: 15 Thieving or access to Zanaris (to acquire cowbells) Questreqstart | no

ironman.t: 20 Smithing (to smelt steel bar for clockwork)
60 Woodcutting (to chop mahogany logs for the plank)
Mahogany logs or mahogany planks may also be obtained as drops from various sources

items.t: Access to a clockmaker's bench 3 or clockmaker's bench 4 (you can use a friend's house if you're not an ironman)
Alternatively, 12 oak planks and 3 molten glass to make the clockmaker's bench 3 from scratch
10 oak planks (protean planks and plank box will not work)
Plank (protean and other types of planks do not work)
Clockwork (or a steel bar to craft one)
Raw cod or a ring of charos (inactivated works)

recommended.t: House teleport runes and activated Fremennik Province, Lumbridge and Varrock lodestone
Gained access to the fairy rings
Kandarin monastery teleport unlocked for faster access to Ardougne Zoo
A weapon to kill the icelords

rewards.t: Ability to make the penguin suit. To enter the suit, you must talk to Larry at the zoo, pier, farm or Iceberg.
Ability to train at the Penguin Agility Course.
Players can also steal more cowbells and make more bongos to play while in a penguin suit.
Ability to contact Larry through the NPC Contact spell.

steps.t: Talk to Larry near the penguin enclosure in the Ardougne Zoo. [Chat: 1 Cold War › Accept]
Talk to Larry again when carrying 10 oak planks and 10 steel nails. [Chat: 1 Cold War › 1 Yes, I have all the materials. › 1 Yes]
Use an oak plank on the firm snow patch.
Attempt to enter the bird hide structure to cover it in snow with spade. [Chat: 1 Yes]
Enter snowy bird hide.
Take note of the emotes the left penguin is doing. The snowy bird hide can be re-entered to watch again if needed. You can check the quest journal later in the quest if you aren't sure.
Talk to Larry. [Chat: Any]
Travel using the nearby boat. [Chat: 1 Yes]
Talk to Larry once on the dock.
Make a clockwork suit on Clockmaker's bench 3 or 4 in a player-owned house, which requires a clockwork, regular plank, and some silk.

sub.t: Making an extra suit at this point is optional for the subsequent quests.

steps.t: Return to Larry (in Ardougne Zoo or north of Fremennik Province lodestone). [Chat: 1 Cold War › 1 Yes, I have it. › 1 Yes]
Talk to Larry on the iceberg. [Chat: 2 It looks like a warning message to keep us away. › 1 Yes]

sub.t: Accept teleport to the Ardougne Zoo.

steps.t: Unequip cape and weapons and use the tuxedo-time option on Larry.
Enter the penguin pen and talk to the penguin.
Use the greeting emotes from earlier. If you haven't noted down the emotes, look in your quest log after you've talked to the penguin.
Read the mission report and exit the penguin pen.
Talk to Larry twice. [Chat: 1 Cold War]
Go to the west section of the Lumbridge cow field by the gate and steal a cowbell from a dairy cow by using the steal-cowbell option for later on in the quest.

sub.t: Players without 15 Thieving can get a cowbell by talking to the dairy cow in Zanaris.

p: Speaking to the penguins in the sheep field, and convincing them that Fred is the king of Lumbridge

steps.t: Talk to Larry inside the sheep pen west of Fred the Farmer's house in Lumbridge.
Enter penguin suit by right clicking Larry and selecting 'tuxedo time' or using the clockwork suit on Larry and talk to the penguins disguised as a sheep (the sheep with flippers).
Do the greeting emotes.
Talk to sheep penguin again.
Talk to Larry twice. [Chat: 1 Yes]
Equip the ring of charos or have a raw cod in the inventory and use the tuxedo-time option on Larry and enter the penguin suit again once at Ardougne Zoo.
Enter penguin pen and talk to penguin. [Chat: 1 The penguins in Lumbridge refuse to talk to me. › 2 I must have left the outpost before they gave out the phrase. › 1 Sure!]
Talk to Larry twice. [Chat: 1 Cold War]
Go back to the Lumbridge sheep pen.
Enter penguin suit by right clicking Larry and selecting 'tuxedo time' or using the clockwork suit on Larry.
Talk to sheep penguin.
Talk to Larry twice.
Talk to Fred the Farmer nearby. [Chat: 2 I need to talk to you about penguins. › Any]

sub.t: Note: Chat options may vary for some players. Choose the option for penguins.

steps.t: Enter penguin suit and talk to sheep penguin again. [Chat: Any]
Talk to Larry twice. [Chat: 1 Yes]
Dismiss any pets or followers.
Talk to Larry on the iceberg and get in the penguin suit again and talk to KGP Agent north-west of Larry.
Do the greeting emotes.
Talk to Noodle twice. [Chat: 1 Yeah, I got it.]
Talk to KGP Agent.

sub.t: Make sure you finish the dialogue or you won't be able to enter the penguin lair.

steps.t: Investigate avalanche just north of KGP Agent.
Enter the first west room.
Talk to KGP Agent.
Exit room through the west door and then through the north door.
Walk north to the agility course.
Climb down the steps and into the water.

sub.t: Stepping across the checkered flag should automatically drop you in water.

steps.t: Avoid the moving ice in the water.
Climb the stepping stone at the end.
Jump across the next stones until you reach the other side.

After crossing, continue on the path until you come to an arch covered in icicles. Use the tread softly option to pass. This must be repeated several times at each arch. Players who fail will be hit with a small amount of damage.

Next, climb up the ice. This can be very annoying, as players lose 20 life points each time they fail, and the failure rate is surprisingly high. For players with low Agility levels, a small amount of food may help.
After that, a short cutscene will play of the player sliding down a hill.
Talk to the Agility Instructor to leave the gate.
Leave the outpost and talk to Larry on the iceberg (twice).
Enter the penguin suit and return to the outpost.
Enter the second east room and talk to Ping and Pong.
p: Ping and Pong with their new instruments

steps.t: Return to Larry and exit penguin suit.
Use a mahogany plank on the leather.
Enter penguin suit and return to Ping and Pong.
Talk to them again. [Chat: 2 Yes.]
Operate the control panel in the north-west corner of the main hall.
Enter the War Room to the east.
Kill an Icelord and exit the pen.
Climb the chasm to the east in the room.
Talk to Larry.
Quest complete!

p: The penguin army are being drilled by the Army Commander for their invasion.

get_inside.text: Players who have completed the easy Ardougne achievements can use the Ardougne cloak 1 to teleport to the Ardougne Monastery and run north
Players with access to the Fairy ring network can use the code DJP to teleport near the Tower of Life and run north-west
Players with access to Spirit trees can teleport to the Khazard Battlefield and run east
Ardougne teleport and run south-west from the city centre
Charter a ship to Ardougne (run south-west) or Port Khazard and run (north-west)
